study.notes: STUDY: single site randomised double blind placebo controlled phase 2b trial (University Hospitals Cleveland, NCT04019197) of weekly semaglutide (titrated to 1 mg) vs placebo for 32 weeks in virologically suppressed adults with HIV, BMI above 25 and lipohypertrophy; 108 randomised (54 per arm), 8 per arm withdrew before week 32; three reports in the group (Clin Infect Dis inflammation markers, AIDS vascular outcomes, Open Forum Infect Dis); Table 3 of the inflammation report prints absolute and percent changes over 32 weeks as medians (IQR) per arm with within arm and between arm rank sum p values, no means or SDs, so no row can be formed under the brief (medians recorded below); population HIV associated lipohypertrophy with overweight, held under amendment A6

json.design: single site randomised double blind placebo controlled phase 2b trial, semaglutide vs placebo, people with HIV and lipohypertrophy with overweight, 108 randomised, 32 weeks
json.reason: population HIV associated lipohypertrophy, held under amendment A6; the inflammatory markers are reported as medians with IQR only (hsCRP absolute change minus 1.17 vs minus 0.11 ug/mL, between arm p 0.02; IL-6 minus 0.39 vs minus 0.25 pg/mL, p 0.43; sICAM-1 minus 4.99 vs minus 6.85 ng/mL, p 0.82), no row can be formed
biomarkers_reported_no_variance: hsCRP (Table 3 medians: absolute change minus 1.17 (minus 3.09 to 0.15) vs minus 0.11 (minus 1.30 to 2.37) ug/mL over 32 weeks, between arm p 0.02; baseline 3.73 vs 5.23 ug/mL)
IL6 (Table 3 medians: minus 0.39 vs minus 0.25 pg/mL, p 0.43)
ICAM1 (sICAM-1, Table 3 medians: minus 4.99 vs minus 6.85 ng/mL, p 0.82)
other_markers: sCD14, sCD163, sVCAM-1, sTNFR-I and II, D-dimer, oxLDL (medians)
pulse wave velocity, coronary artery calcium, reactive hyperaemia index (AIDS report)
Cognivue cognitive scores (Open Forum Infect Dis report)
tables_used: Table 2 and Table 3 of the Clin Infect Dis report

rob.justification: computer generated concealed allocation with matching placebo (D1, D2 low); 8 of 54 per arm withdrew before the primary endpoint (D3 some concerns); laboratory assays (D4 low); registered trial with prespecified secondary biomarker analyses (D5 low)

doubts: held population; even if admitted, the markers are medians only and would need the authors' means or a median to mean conversion the brief does not allow
first author not read from the Clin Infect Dis page header (not needed while no row exists)
